integrity: The all-order statement is supported by a direct necessary-and-sufficient witness proof; finite exhaustive computation is used only as a stress test. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to crown graphs and does not give a general edge-deletion transform for super domination polynomials.
The exhaustive checker covers \(3\le n\le8\); the all-order conclusion is proved symbolically.
The 2024 super-domination-polynomial chapter was available only at abstract/bibliographic level, leaving a residual coverage risk from its uninspected full text.
title: All super dominating sets of crown graphs
